One indexed study is “Recreational music-making modulates the human stress response: a preliminary individualized gene expression strategy” (2005). [1] It reported statistically significant reversals of stress-induced gene-expression changes, including IL6, after recreational music-making. [1] A key limitation is that IL6 reversal also occurred in the resting control group, so that finding alone does not establish a music-making-specific effect. [1]
